# Clawd 动画：ToRouter 项目专项许可 / Project-specific permission

动画素材来自 [clawd-on-desk](https://github.com/rullerzhou-afk/clawd-on-desk)，动画作者：鹿鹿（[@rullerzhou-afk](https://github.com/rullerzhou-afk)）。经作者同意，用于 ToRouter 的非商业使用与改编，并随项目分发。

授权依据：[作者于 2026-10-25 在议题 #1259 的书面回复](https://github.com/rullerzhou-afk/clawd-on-desk/issues/1259#issuecomment-6398719885)。本文件记录该回复的范围，不替代原回复或随附的 [素材许可原文](CLAWD-LICENSE.txt)。

- 同意仅涉及作者创作并有权授权的动画部分，适用于咨询中描述的非商业 ToRouter 项目。
- **不包含任何商业用途的授权。** 素材不适用 ToRouter 自有代码的 MIT 许可，也不适用上游源码的 AGPL-3.0 许可。
- 保留动画作者、项目链接、素材许可及本次非商业许可范围。
- Clawd 角色本身的权利归 Anthropic。本次同意不代表 Anthropic 的官方授权或背书，也不涉及蓝鲸等第三方素材的授权。

ToRouter 自 2026-10-06 起对内联副本进行 SVG/CSS 标识符隔离、场景组合及节奏调整。六个原始 SVG 及 Git blob 见素材来源清单 `SOURCES.json`；原始文件保持不变。

## English

Animation assets are from [clawd-on-desk](https://github.com/rullerzhou-afk/clawd-on-desk), by 鹿鹿 ([@rullerzhou-afk](https://github.com/rullerzhou-afk)). The author agreed to their non-commercial use, adaptation and distribution with the ToRouter project as described in the inquiry.

The [author's written reply of 2026-10-25](https://github.com/rullerzhou-afk/clawd-on-desk/issues/1259#issuecomment-6398719885) is the permission source. This summary does not replace that reply or the accompanying [artwork license](CLAWD-LICENSE.txt).

- Permission covers only animations the author created and is entitled to authorize, for the non-commercial ToRouter project described in the inquiry.
- **No commercial use is authorized.** These assets are excluded from both ToRouter's MIT source-code license and the upstream AGPL-3.0 source-code license.
- Retain the animation author's credit, project link, artwork license and this permission's non-commercial scope.
- The Clawd character belongs to Anthropic. This permission is not official authorization or endorsement by Anthropic and does not cover the blue whale or other third-party assets.

ToRouter's adaptations since 2026-10-06 include SVG/CSS identifier scoping, scene composition and timing adjustments to inline copies. The six original SVGs remain unchanged; their Git blobs are recorded in the asset source manifest, `SOURCES.json`.
